== Usage ==
<pre>==== Book One: Survival ({{Survival}}) ====</pre>
"Survival" in Avatarian, for the ''Avatar: Seven Havens'' Book One heading.
Write that heading exactly as above on every page: its TOC anchor,
<code>#Book_One:_Survival_(Survival)</code>, is what MediaWiki:Avatarian.css
keys on to draw the glyphs in the table of contents too (see TOC_WORDS in
tools/build_css_only.py). Changing the heading's English or this template's
label breaks the TOC glyphs until the CSS is regenerated to match.
</noinclude>
